core_entities.name: DoorFR2LampOnOff_1
core_entities.description: Control signal to turn the front right door ambient lamp ON or OFF.

core_entities.name: DoorFR2LampColorCmd_1
core_entities.description: Command signal to set the color of the front right door ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: DoorFR2LampBrtnsCmd_1
core_entities.description: Command signal to adjust the brightness of the front right door ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: DoorFR2LampBrthngCmd_1
core_entities.description: Command signal to control the breathing (pulsing) effect of the front right door ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: RHZCU
core_entities.description: Right Hand Zone Control Unit responsible for processing and executing lighting commands.

core_entities.name: LIN
core_entities.description: Local Interconnect Network used for transmitting signals between modules.

core_conditions.name: DoorFR2LampOnOff_1_0_OFF
core_conditions.description: Request to turn the lamp OFF.

core_conditions.name: DoorFR2LampOnOff_1_1_ON
core_conditions.description: Request to turn the lamp ON.

core_conditions.name: DoorFR2LampColorCmd_1_0_No Request
core_conditions.description: No color request is made; lamp retains current color.

core_conditions.name: DoorFR2LampBrtnsCmd_1_0_No Request
core_conditions.description: No brightness adjustment request is made; lamp retains current brightness.

core_conditions.name: DoorFR2LampBrthngCmd_1_RateX
core_conditions.description: Sets the breathing rate of the lamp to a specific level (Rate1 to Rate15).

core_outputs.name: DoorAmbtLampB_FR
core_outputs.description: The actual behavior of the front right door ambient lamp as commanded.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the communication protocol and command structure for controlling the front right door ambient lamp's on/off state, color, brightness, and breathing effects via the LIN bus to the RHZCU. It specifies how different command values map to specific lamp behaviors.
